workload.name: заказы клиента
workload.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE id BETWEEN {{id}} AND {{id}} + 50

workload.name: новый заказ
workload.sql: INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, total, note) VALUES (1 + ({{seq}} % 1000), 10, 'x')

workload.name: смена статуса
workload.sql: UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid' WHERE id = {{id}}
